topic: Choose a textbook for the intro statistics course

scenario.topic: Choose a textbook for the intro statistics course
scenario.opening_question: What balance of cost, clarity, and depth do we want in our intro statistics textbook?

options.name: Statistics for Engineers and Scientists 5th Edition
options.upside: Comprehensive coverage with practical engineering examples
options.tradeoff: Dense and may be overwhelming for non-engineering majors
options.concern: May not engage students outside STEM fields effectively
options.best_for: Depth and real-world application for STEM-focused students

options.name: Introductory Statistics with R 2nd Edition
options.upside: Integrates R programming for hands-on data analysis
options.tradeoff: Requires students to learn some programming alongside statistics
options.concern: Could intimidate students with no coding background
options.best_for: Practical data skills and modern computational approach

options.name: The Practice of Statistics 7th Edition
options.upside: Student-friendly explanations with strong AP exam alignment
options.tradeoff: Less depth in theory compared to other textbooks
options.concern: May be too simplified for some college-level expectations
options.best_for: Clarity and exam preparation for diverse student backgrounds

options.name: Statistics: Unlocking the Power of Data 1st Edition
options.upside: Engaging activities and accessible writing for beginners
options.tradeoff: Newer edition with less established reputation
options.concern: Some instructors may find it lacking in advanced content
options.best_for: Engagement and accessibility for students new to statistics

shared_context: The course starts in 6 weeks and the textbook must be ordered within 2 weeks
Budget limit is $120 per copy for students
The decision group has exactly 3 faculty members selecting the textbook

personas.name: Diego
personas.background: Diego is an engineering professor who values comprehensive and practical examples to prepare STEM students for real-world applications.
personas.private_goal: He prefers a textbook that offers depth and practical engineering-focused content to challenge and engage his students.

personas.name: Sami
personas.background: Sami is a beginner-friendly course instructor who cares most about student engagement and accessibility to statistics for non-technical majors.
personas.private_goal: She prefers a textbook that is approachable and includes interactive activities to keep students motivated and involved.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference

personas.private_goal: He prefers a textbook that integrates programming with statistics to equip students with hands-on analytical experience.
